threat_event: Takeover of the owner's email account, which is the administrator and recovery address for every system of all four entities
threat_source: Cybercriminal (phishing page that relays the text-message code)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Text-message MFA only; one account for daily email and administration; no recovery codes; no sign-in review
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 and, through password resets, SYS-02 to SYS-07 (BP-01 to BP-05)
treatment_plan: Authenticator app now; hardware security key with a spare in the sealed envelope; separate administrator account; monthly sign-in review; phishing briefing; P08 runbook

threat_event: Payment redirection: a fake or altered bank-change request or invoice is paid from an LLC account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank-detail changes accepted by email; no callback; bookkeeper has full payee rights in all four company files; the owner releases payments alone
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 and SYS-03 (BP-03); all four bank accounts
existing_controls: Bank one-time code for new payees; bank alert for every outgoing payment
treatment_plan: Written callback rule for any new or changed payee, using a number already on file; payee changes by the owner only; bookkeeper role reduced; payment fraud briefing for the bookkeeper

threat_event: Rental applications, screening reports, and driver license scans kept for years are exposed in a breach or disposed of improperly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 47 application files with SSNs and screening reports and about 230 driver license scans in general file storage; no retention or disposal rule
existing_controls: Screening reports delivered inside the platform
treatment_plan: Retention schedule in POL-01 8.7; keep applications only in the platform; delete downloads and old scans; shred paper

threat_event: A former employee or anyone who knows a shared credential uses it to read tenant data or change records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Former storage assistant's account active until 2026-07-30; shared Laundry PIN and mailbox password unchanged after an attendant left; no account reviews
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05; SYS-07; shared Laundry mailbox (BP-02, BP-04)
treatment_plan: Individual PINs and delegated mailbox access; same-day removal checklist; quarterly account review for every LLC system

threat_event: The Storage office desktop is stolen or misused, exposing tenant records and the manager's mailbox
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared local account with no password; no disk encryption; manager's mailbox stays signed in and has no MFA
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-09 Storage desktop; SYS-05; SYS-01 manager mailbox (BP-02)
existing_controls: Office locked when the manager is out
treatment_plan: Individual sign-in with screen lock; built-in disk encryption; MFA on the manager's mailbox and storage system account

threat_event: A laundromat customer on the free Wi-Fi attacks the POS tablet or payment hub
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer Wi-Fi on the same network as the POS tablet and payment hub
regulatory_driver: CSF 2.0 portfolio profile PR.IR-01 (voluntary); card processor terms (contract)
existing_controls: Card data encrypted by the vendor's readers; POS app uses TLS
treatment_plan: Turn on the router's guest network for customers

threat_event: Someone uses the gate controller's default administrator password to open the gate or change codes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Installer default password; controller reachable from the Storage office network; firmware never updated
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-09 gate controller; SYS-05 gate integration (BP-02)
existing_controls: Controller on the office network only (not exposed to the internet, per the installer)
treatment_plan: Change the password with the installer; store it in the password manager; firmware check each July

threat_event: Email and files are lost to deletion, an attacker, or an account lockout, with no copy to restore from
threat_source: Account compromise, owner error, or vendor lockout
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No backup beyond 30-day deleted-item retention; no exports from LLC systems; applications exist only in the suite
existing_controls: Vendors' own platform backups; 30-day deleted-item retention
treatment_plan: Backup service for suite mail and files; monthly exports from the accounting, storage, and property management systems; first restore test

threat_event: The AI assistant is used on rental applications and to suggest which applicant to choose, or surfaces one LLC's Restricted data in another LLC's work
threat_source: Owner misuse of an AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Assistant turned on 2026-06-01 with no rules; it reads all four entities' mail and files; used on 2026-07-14 on six applications with screening reports
existing_controls: Owner re-checked the unit 4B decision against written criteria on 2026-07-30
treatment_plan: POL-01 9.5 rules: no applicant, tenant, or employee decisions with AI; no Restricted data in prompts; Restricted folder excluded from the assistant (P10)

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable or loses the only phone, so nobody can reach any system, release payroll, or answer tenants for four entities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every administrator credential and payment right; MFA codes go to one phone; the successor manager has authority but no access path
existing_controls: Successor manager named in each LLC operating agreement
treatment_plan: Sealed access sheet and recovery codes with the business attorney; limited Storage authority for the manager; ask the bank how the successor becomes a signer; spare hardware key (P05)

threat_event: A vendor or the bookkeeper suffers a breach that exposes the LLCs' data, and the owner learns late or not at all
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vendor list; bookkeeper has full access with no confidentiality or security terms; vendor notices go only to the owner's mailbox
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02; SYS-04 to SYS-07; bookkeeper systems
existing_controls: IT technician agreement signed 2026-07-24; accounting service SOC 2 reviewed 2026-07-29
treatment_plan: Vendor list with data held and notice contacts; confidentiality and security terms with the bookkeeper; register a security contact with each vendor

threat_event: A security incident is not recognized, or a Florida breach notice deadline is missed, because nobody knows which LLC must notify whom
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan or contact list; four separate covered entities; the 30-day clock starts at determination
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and four-entity notification matrix; print contacts; annual walkthrough

threat_event: The storage system or laundry payment platform is down longer than the BIA allows
existing_controls: Gate works on stored codes; coin machines; paper forms and tickets
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Keep paper move-in forms and order tickets at each site

threat_event: A hurricane closes the Storage office and laundromat for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two physical sites; site devices on premises
existing_controls: All systems are cloud-hosted and reachable from the owner's phone
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Unplug site equipment and move the Storage desktop off the floor when a storm watch is issued

threat_event: Credential stuffing or password guessing opens an LLC administrator account that has no MFA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No password manager; one password reused on the storage system and laundry platform; MFA off on both
treatment_plan: Password manager with unique passphrases; MFA on both administrator accounts
